# Audette IT — full site content

> Every page of audetteit.com in one file, for AI agents and anyone who wants plain text. Generated from the per-page Markdown files; the HTML pages are the canonical versions.

## How this site serves Markdown

- Each page has a Markdown twin: `/` is `/index.md`, `/services` is `/services.md`, and so on.
- Requesting any page URL with `Accept: text/markdown` returns the same Markdown with `Content-Type: text/markdown`. Those responses send `Vary: Accept`.
- Markdown responses carry a `Link: <...>; rel="canonical"` header pointing at the HTML page.
- Index of pages: https://audetteit.com/llms.txt
- XML sitemap: https://audetteit.com/sitemap.xml

## Audette IT

> Personal IT help for family and friends, from everyday fixes to real network and Active Directory work. Not a registered business.

### Uptime isn't luck. It's a system someone is actually watching.

Audette IT is one person who knows what they're doing — from forgotten passwords to full network and Active Directory builds, for family and friends who'd rather not guess.

- [Contact](https://audetteit.com/contact.md)
- [See what I do](https://audetteit.com/services.md)

### Coverage: two speeds, everyday help and the deep stuff

Most requests are a quick fix. Some need a network redesign. Both get the same attention — and unlike most family tech support, the second kind is actually on the table.

| Tier | What it covers | Speed |
|---|---|---|
| Everyday help | Wifi and device troubleshooting, slow computers, printers, locked-out accounts, parental controls on the kids' devices. | Quick |
| Infrastructure & advanced | Home network design, Active Directory and domain setups, self-hosted services, real security hardening. | Deep |

[See the full list](https://audetteit.com/services.md)

### Process: the same four stages, every time

Whether it's setting something up for the first time or fixing something that broke tonight.

1. **Assess** — Figure out what's actually going on before changing anything.
2. **Deploy** — Roll out the fix or setup in a way that doesn't break what's already working.
3. **Monitor** — Keep an eye on it afterward instead of disappearing once it's "done."
4. **Respond** — If it acts up again, it gets triaged and fixed — same process, no starting over.

### Something acting up, or planning something new?

[Contact](https://audetteit.com/contact.md) — or email michael.audette@audetteit.com.

## What I can actually help with

> Two tiers: quick everyday fixes, and full infrastructure work most family tech support can't touch.

### Tier 1: Everyday help

The stuff that comes up constantly — usually fixable the same day.

- **Wifi & devices** — Dead spots, dropped connections, new devices that won't join the network.
- **Slow computers** — Cleanup, startup bloat, storage, and figuring out what's actually causing the slowdown.
- **Printers & peripherals** — Getting printers, scanners, and other devices talking to everything else again.
- **Accounts & software** — Locked-out accounts, confusing settings, software that's stopped making sense.
- **Parental controls** — Setting up screen time limits, content filtering, and app restrictions on kids' devices.

### Tier 2: Infrastructure & advanced

Real infrastructure work — the kind you'd otherwise need to hire an actual IT company for.

- **Network design** — Planning and configuring home or small-office networks from the ground up — routing, segmentation, Wi-Fi coverage.
- **Active Directory / domains** — Setting up and managing domain controllers, user accounts, and group policy — the kind of setup most households never have.
- **Self-hosted services** — Running your own media, backup, or other services on hardware you actually control, instead of renting everything from someone else.
- **Security hardening** — Firewalls, access control, and closing the gaps that most default home setups leave wide open.

This list grows as more gets built out.

### Something that doesn't fit either list?

[Get in touch anyway](https://audetteit.com/contact.md).

## Tell me what you're running

> A quick fix, an ongoing setup, or something more involved — send the details and I'll follow up.

**Email:** michael.audette@audetteit.com

### Contact form

The form at https://audetteit.com/contact asks for:

- **Name**
- **Email**
- **What's going on?**
- A checkbox: "I'm okay with this info being used to follow up with me." (see the [privacy note](https://audetteit.com/privacy.md))

It opens your email app with the message filled in — nothing is sent until you hit send there. Emailing the address above directly works just as well.

Source: https://audetteit.com/privacy

## What this site collects

> Short version: very little, and nothing is sold or shared.

### The contact form

The form on the [contact page](https://audetteit.com/contact.md) doesn't send anything to a server. When you hit send, it opens your own email app with your name, email, and message filled in — nothing leaves your device until you send that email yourself. Once it arrives, I use it only to reply to you.

### Analytics and cookies

This site doesn't run analytics and doesn't set any cookies. If that changes, this page will be updated first.

### Hosting

The site is hosted on Cloudflare, which processes standard request data (like IP addresses) to serve and protect the site. That's covered by [Cloudflare's privacy policy](https://www.cloudflare.com/privacypolicy/).

Fonts load from Google Fonts, so your browser also makes a request to Google's servers when a page loads. Google Fonts doesn't set cookies; see [Google's Fonts privacy FAQ](https://developers.google.com/fonts/faq/privacy).

### Questions

Email michael.audette@audetteit.com if you want to know what I have from you, or want it deleted.
